lines: Two hour workouts. Five a.m. alarms. A whole new *life.*
The plan was too big. The body got *tired.*
And all that intensity turned into *nothing.*
Thirty minutes every day beats three hours once a *month.*
One page every night beats a whole book you never *finish.*
They come from your *average* day, repeated.
So lower the bar. Make it so easy you can't say *no.*
Small enough to do on your *worst* day.
On the days you're excited. And the days you're *not.*
You'll know it was just *showing up.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Consistency Beats Intensity. Every Time.
post.caption: Results come from your average day, repeated. 🔁
post.first_comment: What's one small thing you'll do every day this month? 👇
